snippet.title: STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions - PC & Console Beta Announcement Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454370 

STARSEEKER is a new game set within the Astroneer universe, focusing on discovery, cooperative expeditions, and camaraderie. Players will need to work together with their squad and the entire space station crew to explore the planet Tephra, accomplish dynamic objectives, and bring resources back to the station to complete the STARSEEKER community's overall goals. The new 'Wildlife of Tephra' trailer shows some of the unusual creatures players will encounter on the ground—creatures they will need to analyse, avoid, or pacify—and announces the upcoming open beta in April. Players can sign up for the open beta at starseekergame.com and are encouraged to invite their most trusted squadmates to jump in for shenanigans and adventure.

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative 

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more over on https://iii-initiative.com
